strings.site.tagline: Every era’s vocal chain. One plugin.
strings.site.description: One vocal plugin with a whole vocal chain for each artist and era — tuning, EQ, compression, de-essing, delays, reverbs and the vocal bus — built from its own modules. CLAP, VST3 and AU for Windows, macOS and Linux. Offline and 100% AI-free.
strings.price.note: Nothing is for sale yet. From version 1.0, Freally Takelight will be sold as a one-time licence, with a free trial of the whole plugin first.
